label: TSMM to DCAS binding
description: Maps DTG Conformance & Assurance System (DCAS) concepts into TSMM abstractions for assurance, evidence, and evaluation workflows.

mappings.description: Normative expectation used to govern evaluation and downstream trust effects.
Structured evidence set used to substantiate conformance and assurance posture.
Formal evaluation activity over declared controls and observed evidence.
Profile defining rigor, evidence depth, and assessment expectations.
Actor evaluating whether evidence and controls are sufficient in context.

notes: DCAS is assurance-heavy and maps most directly into the policy, evidence, assessment, and profile surfaces of TSMM.
This binding is semantic and explanatory. It does not replace DCAS terminology or normative requirements.

guarantees.name: assurance-alignment
guarantees.description: DCAS evidence, assessment, and assurance concepts map directly into TSMM assurance surfaces.

guarantees.name: evaluation-traceability
guarantees.description: Assessment activities and evidence bundles can be represented as traceable TSMM objects.

guarantees.name: control-catalog-preservation
guarantees.description: Control objectives map to TSMM policy abstractions, but fine-grained control taxonomies remain ecosystem-specific.

limitations.name: assessment procedure specificity
limitations.impact: TSMM does not substitute for DCAS assessment method definitions or scoring logic.
limitations.mitigation: Pair TSMM with DCAS-specific procedures when conducting formal evaluation.

behavioralExpectations.expectation: Assessments preserve linkage among control objectives, evidence, and resulting trust decisions.
Assurance profiles remain explicit inputs to decisioning rather than background documentation.

notes: Use for semantic alignment and assurance design; DCAS-specific assessment procedures remain authoritative.
